# Tech Genz

> **Ideas Engineered Beyond Limits**  
> 🌐 [techgenz.site](https://techgenz.site/) • 📧 [admin@techgenz.site](mailto:admin@techgenz.site)

Tech Genz is a software and technology team building practical web applications, cloud infrastructure, and interactive 3D digital experiences. Formed by members of the student community at **N.B.K.R. Institute of Science & Technology (NBKRIST)** in Vidyanagar, AP, India, our team collaborates on real-world software engineering projects.

---

### 🚀 Flagship Projects

- **[SharePinz](https://sharepinz.site/)**: PIN-based ephemeral file sharing platform. Send files with a temporary 6-digit access code and automated TTL expiry.
- **[Tech Genz Experience](https://techgenz.site/)**: Interactive 3D portfolio and creative engineering showcase built with Three.js, React 19, and Vite.
